courses.title: Course 3
courses.description: Accelerated middle-school mathematics focused on real numbers, linear relationships, functions, geometry, and bivariate data.

units.title: Real Numbers and Exponents
units.description: Build a strong foundation with rational and irrational numbers before moving into radicals, exponents, and scientific notation.

concepts.title: Rational and Irrational Numbers
concepts.description: Classify real numbers by recognizing fractions, terminating and repeating decimals, square roots, and nonrepeating decimals.

concepts.title: Repeating Decimals as Fractions
concepts.description: Use place value and algebra to convert repeating decimals into exact fractions and explain why the method works.

concepts.title: Square Roots and Perfect Squares
concepts.description: Recognize perfect squares, evaluate principal square roots, and connect square roots with equations and square area.

concepts.title: Cube Roots and Perfect Cubes
concepts.description: Recognize perfect cubes, evaluate positive and negative cube roots, and connect cube roots with equations and volume.

concepts.title: Approximate Irrational Numbers
concepts.description: Locate irrational numbers between rational benchmarks, approximate them to a requested precision, and compare or apply their values.

concepts.title: Compare and Order Real Numbers
concepts.description: Compare and order rational and irrational values using exact simplification, benchmarks, approximations, and number-line reasoning.

concepts.title: Integer Exponents
concepts.description: Interpret powers and use positive-integer exponent laws to simplify numerical and algebraic expressions with clear reasoning.

concepts.title: Zero and Negative Exponents
concepts.description: Extend exponent rules to zero and negative exponents, rewrite expressions with positive exponents, and explain reciprocal reasoning.

concepts.title: Powers of Ten
concepts.description: Use powers of ten to represent, compare, and scale large and small quantities by reasoning about place value.

concepts.title: Scientific Notation
concepts.description: Write, interpret, compare, and convert very large and very small quantities using scientific notation.

concepts.title: Operations with Scientific Notation
concepts.description: Multiply, divide, add, subtract, estimate, and interpret quantities written in scientific notation.

concepts.title: Unit 1 Mixed Review
concepts.description: Review real numbers, radicals, exponent rules, powers of ten, and scientific notation across the full Unit 1 progression.

units.title: Linear Equations in One Variable
units.description: Build from equivalent expressions into multi-step linear equations, special solution cases, and equation modeling.

concepts.title: Review Equivalent Expressions
concepts.description: Review combining like terms, distribution, factoring, and equivalent-expression reasoning before solving linear equations.

concepts.title: Solve Multi-Step Equations
concepts.description: Solve one-variable equations that require simplifying, inverse operations, negative coefficients, fractions, decimals, and solution checks.

concepts.title: Equations with the Distributive Property
concepts.description: Solve one-variable equations that require distributing, handling negative factors, combining like terms, and checking in the original equation.

concepts.title: Equations with Variables on Both Sides
concepts.description: Solve one-variable equations by moving variable terms, moving constants, distributing when needed, and checking solutions.

concepts.title: Equations with Rational Coefficients
concepts.description: Solve one-variable equations with fraction and decimal coefficients by clearing denominators, combining terms, and checking solutions.

concepts.title: One Solution, No Solution, or Infinitely Many Solutions
concepts.description: Classify linear equations by simplifying both sides and comparing variable terms and constants.

concepts.title: Build Equations from Context
concepts.description: Translate situations into one-variable equations by identifying constants, rates, variables, and equal quantities.

concepts.title: Linear Equation Word Problems
concepts.description: Solve one-variable linear equation word problems by defining a variable, building an equation, solving, and interpreting the answer.

concepts.title: Check and Explain Equation Solutions
concepts.description: Check proposed solutions in original equations and explain whether solving steps preserve equality.

concepts.title: Unit 2 Mixed Review
concepts.description: Review equivalent expressions, multi-step equations, distributive property equations, rational coefficients, solution types, modeling, and checking solutions.

units.title: Unit 3 — Lines, Slope, and Linear Equations
units.description: Understand slope, rate of change, proportional linear equations, and multiple representations of lines.

concepts.title: Proportional Relationships as Lines
concepts.description: Connect proportional relationships to lines through the origin and equations of the form y = mx.

concepts.title: Understand Slope as Rate of Change
concepts.description: Interpret slope as a constant rate of change in tables, graphs, equations, and contexts.

concepts.title: Find Slope from Graphs
concepts.description: Find slope on coordinate graphs by using rise over run between two points on a line.

concepts.title: Find Slope from Tables and Points
concepts.description: Calculate slope from tables and coordinate pairs using change in y over change in x.

concepts.title: Compare Rates of Change
concepts.description: Compare rates of change across proportional relationships, tables, graphs, and contexts.

concepts.title: Similar Triangles and Constant Slope
concepts.description: Use similar slope triangles to explain why a line has a constant slope.

concepts.title: Equations in the Form y = mx
concepts.description: Write and interpret proportional linear equations in the form y = mx.
